name: P1088: a work dist/ without its circuit.json is kept over the earlier one (test_a_work_dist_without_a_circuit_keeps_the_earlier_dist_and_names_it, test_a_work_dist_without_a_circuit_and_no_earlier_dist_makes_none)
P1088: the work dist/ is merged over the earlier one, whose files stay (test_a_build_with_problems_replaces_the_earlier_dist_whole, test_a_finished_build_replaces_the_earlier_dist_whole)
P1088: a dist/ whose copy failed is also named left alone (test_an_unfinished_build_whose_dist_cannot_be_copied_says_not_kept_once)
find: or str(old) in {entry["file"] for entry in kept}:
replace: or str(old) in {entry["file"] for entry in kept if entry["did"] == WROTE}:

name: P1088: the build phase does not name a dist/ the last build did not write (test_a_build_that_did_not_write_dist_says_so_in_the_build_phase)
find: says += [line for line in [earlier_dist(project)] if line]

name: P1088: the earlier dist/ is removed before the copy, so a copy that fails leaves no board (test_a_copy_that_fails_leaves_the_earlier_dist_whole)
